data.body:
Merged as change 2306. _diagnose_non_killed's mutmut run is now wrapped with the same (root, basetemp) allow-list contract as execute_shard and uses sandbox_env, so the hardened HOME applies too.

The per-function binding tests could not have caught this: they scanned execute_shard only, so a call site in another function was invisible. The binding tests now scan the WHOLE MODULE for both the wrapper and the hardened env, so a fourth mutmut run site fails the suite instead of silently reopening the hole.

Added an enforcement test for the diagnostic allow-list that observes a real denial with a liveness check rather than asserting argv shape. It proves denial with a CREATE: a leaked create is inert, whereas proving it with a delete would cause real damage on the day the sandbox stopped enforcing.

RED proofs, all by real mutation: unwrapping the diagnostic run -> module-wide wrapper test failed; giving that child the unhardened env -> module-wide env test failed; narrowing the scan back to execute_shard only -> failed on the site-count assertion, proving the generalisation is itself load-bearing. Gate classes 1874 passed, 4 skipped; CI green on all cells.
